# Module Index by Group

<!-- Auto-generated by scripts/rskit_tool.py groups module-index from `toven groups` - do not edit manually -->

Groups are declared in `toven.toml` `[groups.*]`, listed bottom-up. Check one with `make check-<group>`.

## core  (`make check-core`)

Foundation types, config, logging, validation, encryption, filesystem utilities.
May depend on: no other group.

rskit-codec · rskit-config · rskit-encryption · rskit-errors · rskit-fs · rskit-logging · rskit-schema · rskit-stream · rskit-util · rskit-validation · rskit-version

## patterns  (`make check-patterns`)

Component lifecycle, provider shapes, DI, hooks.
May depend on: core.

rskit-component · rskit-di · rskit-hook · rskit-provider

## crosscutting  (`make check-crosscutting`)

Observability, resilience, security.
May depend on: core, patterns, testing.

rskit-observability · rskit-resilience · rskit-security

## composition  (`make check-composition`)

Bootstrap, DAG, chain, worker, process, stateful.
May depend on: core, crosscutting, patterns, testing.

rskit-bootstrap · rskit-chain · rskit-dag · rskit-process · rskit-stateful · rskit-worker

## transport  (`make check-transport`)
